scope: offline local UX-01 concept preview only; not a full application or /analytics reproduction

text_200_simulation.method: snapshot computed font sizes for all elements, then double each once by inline !important assignment; restore before next case
limitations: This is a computed-font-size simulation, not Chrome or operating-system text zoom.
It doubles element font-size values and can also change em/rem-derived geometry; native zoom can behave differently.
Only the five visible screen compositions at 390px and 1280px are evaluated, in light theme.
Pseudo-element text is not an independently addressable DOM element and is not directly modified.

details.saved_status: Черновик отмечен как сохранённый до перезагрузки страницы.

limitations: Loads only the supplied local HTML file. It does not import Flask/app code, seller data, or API responses.
HTTP and HTTPS requests are intercepted and aborted; file:// resources remain allowed.
A clean synthetic preview result cannot prove a full-app defect is fixed or reproduce /analytics. Real viewport and browser evidence for that finding remains separate.
One local Chrome build is used; results do not establish behavior across all browser versions or operating systems.
